who_he_is.name: Lorren Rossi
who_he_is.status: outdated. out of commission in 'a few years.' said 'just' like it was nothing.
who_he_is.voice: robotic, inhumane tone. male. young-sounding despite being a machine.
who_he_is.head: small television screen instead of a face. two crossing lines = eyes. shifts to vertical lines with soft green light when being friendly.
who_he_is.body: scrapped titanium with brass linings. 315lbs for average height and build. heavy enough to dent floors. loose wires on the back of the neck — HDMI ports.
who_he_is.demeanor: polite. bowed on introduction. courteous. stands idle by furniture like he's trying to be unobtrusive despite being 315lbs of metal.
who_he_is.name_origin: italian surname — rossi. first name lorren.

what_sora_knows_so_far.found_her_online: old department page, three years stale. came looking for someone who can 'read the stars.'
what_sora_knows_so_far.came_alone: at midnight. to a rural observatory. on purpose.
what_sora_knows_so_far.surprised_by_water: genuinely confused that sora offered water. 'you — i had JUST mentioned i am an automata.' didn't expect kindness? or didn't expect someone to forget he's a machine?
what_sora_knows_so_far.munji_likes_him: the cat went to him immediately. twice. currently sleeping at his feet.

open_questions: why does he need someone who 'reads the stars'?
what does 'out of commission' mean for him — shutdown? decay? someone turns him off?
why is he outdated — is there a newer model?
why did he come HERE specifically? there are astronomers everywhere.
does he feel cold? does he feel anything?
why was he surprised by the water offer?
